findings.description: The function configuration embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext environment variables. Lambda environment configuration can be read by principals with function configuration access, and committing these credentials to IaC makes them exposed and reusable outside the function.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is deprecated and no longer receives security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may therefore remain exploitable in the deployed function.
